purpose: Synthetic accounting example, not a submission-ready manuscript
abstract: Two analytical response curves illustrate a figure workflow. Their differences are defined by their generating functions and do not establish an empirical mechanism.
body: We compare two analytical response curves to illustrate fixed-size figure export. Figure 1 shows their values with illustrative deviations. Both curves are specified by construction; no experimental measurement or mechanistic test is implied.
captions: Figure 1. Two synthetic response series. Circles and squares identify the series, and solid and dashed curves show their generating functions. Bars show fixed illustrative deviations of 0.025 arbitrary units, not measured statistical uncertainty.
